snippet.text: theorem correctionJet_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1/120) (amp : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) {eta : ℝ} (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) (y : ℝ) : |correctionJet c amp k eta y| ≤ (2 * correctionJetBound c.P c.m k) * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (1 + |amp eta|), where correctionJet … k eta y = iteratedDeriv k (fun t => correction c amp eta (Real.exp t)) y
